research_role: implementation repair plus minimal causal discrimination; all listed windows are development diagnostics after inspection
unchanged_contracts: NautilusTrader BacktestNode owns event replay, matching, fills, fees, positions and account NAV
one shared venue account across BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT and XRPUSDT
unfilled new-entry intents plus open positions never exceed one
planned loss budget is current shared NAV times exactly 3 percent including configured entry and stop costs
v52 and v53 indicator thresholds, confirmation state machine, structural stop, liquidity objective and management are not tuned in this experiment

implementation_hypothesis.observation: The only historical v52 Actions run passed the focused causal unit tests but failed before NautilusTrader started because the workflow overwrote strategy_v36_cross_asset_repricing_gate.py and removed SystemicRepricingGateMixin, which strategy_global_slot_wrappers_v4 imports.
implementation_hypothesis.prediction: Explicit v52/v53 wrappers using the existing SharedAccountEntryLifecycleMixin will import without mutating v36, produce four strategy diagnostics, and either produce valid economic evidence or a new independently identifiable implementation failure.
implementation_hypothesis.falsification: Any import error, missing diagnostics, account-integrity failure, order rejection/denial, future-peer use, or global-slot violation falsifies the repaired execution path; economic results must not be interpreted until repaired.

h52_idiosyncratic_convergence.market_claim: A target asset that is a robust-MAD residual extreme relative to the prior-only three-peer common factor should mean-revert only after residual compression starts, OI is not expanding, and local aggressor/depth turn toward convergence.
predicted_observable_changes: v52_setups must be a strict subset of v52_extremes and v52_inflections
closed v52 trades should originate from CROSS_SECTIONAL_RESIDUAL_REJECTION episodes rather than unrelated parent-family branches
winning episodes should show residual travel toward the peer-implied objective; an unrelated market beta move is not supporting evidence

if opportunity density is low, the funnel location must identify whether the missing state is peer context, extreme, inflection, OI contraction, flow/depth confirmation, confirmation/retest, or global-slot arbitration
falsification: residual-rejection episodes have negative cost-after expectancy across the diagnostic windows despite valid implementation
wins are dominated by one outlier while typical residual travel does not converge
the strategy repeatedly trades systemic common-factor repricing as if it were idiosyncratic dislocation
the majority of economically attractive ex-post residual convergences were rejected for a reason unrelated to the stated state model

h53_state_competition.market_claim: When the peer common factor has already moved materially, the target is an opposite-residual laggard, OI is expanding, and target flow/depth align with the common move, the correct action is catch-up continuation rather than v52 mean-reversion fade.
predicted_observable_changes: v53 must preserve genuine v52 OI-contraction residual-rejection episodes unless a mutually exclusive catch-up state is present
new v53 trades must be attributable to CROSS_SECTIONAL_CATCHUP episodes with positive OI and aligned multi-horizon flow/depth
any v53 improvement over v52 must be explained by those newly routed catch-up episodes or by avoiding a specifically identified false fade, not by unrelated outlier winners

if catch-up setups occur but lose, inspect whether the failure is state direction, confirmation timing, objective exhaustion, invalidation geometry, or execution; do not tune COMMON_FACTOR_MIN_ATR from the headline result
falsification: v53 creates no catch-up setups despite windows containing common-factor impulses and residual laggards, after implementation/reachability is verified
catch-up episodes have negative cost-after expectancy and do not reduce the false-fade loss engine
v53 destroys or materially changes genuine v52 convergence winners without an explicit state conflict
headline improvement comes from unrelated parent branches, changed fills, or one extreme winner rather than the preregistered rerouting mechanism
